title: The reporter and the agent
summary: The reporter has found out where the money for your agent's fiftieth came from: a club that wanted you. She has the invoice for the fountain. Your agent rings you before she does.

ends.title: Both friends
ends.text: The reporter and your agent sat down in the same café and sorted it out. They still don't like each other.

ends.title: The agent goes
ends.text: Your agent went quietly after the reporter's story. You found a new one who doesn't own a fountain.

ends.title: The story spiked
ends.text: The reporter's story never ran. You still don't know if your agent made a call.

beats.title: The fountain invoice

event.title: The fountain invoice
event.speaker: reporter
setup: Your agent rings at ten at night, which he never does. "That reporter of yours. She's got the invoice for the fountain. It was paid by a club, and she thinks it's about you."

say: "It was a gift. Clubs give gifts. Just tell her to drop it."

replies.label: "I'll get you both in a room."

meet.text: A café, three teas, nobody drinking theirs. It takes an hour. Your agent goes very red twice.

cover.text: You ring her. She listens to the whole thing and then says, "Right," in a voice you haven't heard before.

leave.text: You put the phone down on him. Then you lie awake.

beats.hint: The reporter has an invoice from your agent's party

beats.title: A season on

event.title: A season on
event.speaker: reporter
setup: A season on. You see them both in the car park at the same game, at the same time, and they both see you.

choices.label: Walk over to both of them.

outcomes.text: She says something and he laughs, a real one. They've sorted it out.
He goes back to his car. A week later he tells you he's retiring.
He's very pleased with himself. The story never ran.
He shakes your hand and says she's all right, for a reporter.
